purpose: Configure original source acquisition and review for prepare-master.mjs, prepare-work-orders.mjs and the existing six-domain/work-order migration engine. This file performs no network request or posting.
unconfiguredMeaning: Null selections are deliberately unconfigured. Use actual authorized environment/company and retained installed metadata; never use documentation example IDs.

companyContext.requiredWhen: selection.expenseLineCostField selects an LCY line amount

captureFields.url: exact credential-free original HTTPS GET URL

bindings.source: company GUID in original response request path
bindings.rule: same actual company as the selected Dynaway response
native response GUID equals setup GUID in request URI
exact original code; must also satisfy the current engine's three-uppercase-letter currency constraint
retain reviewer reference plus computed response bytes/SHA/pointer; a free-text code alone is insufficient

readPlan.limits: Currencies list is not the LCY authority; LCY rounding may require a separately retained setup export because standard generalLedgerSetup lists no amount-rounding field.
These are G/L parent dimension lines, not an inferred Dynaway order-to-G/L link; retain actual linkage evidence.
Resolve supported collection/key routes against installed metadata. Default dimensions are not proof of posted dimensions.

canonicalMappings.source: valueCode for the dimension whose code equals captured shortcutDimension1Code
canonicalMappings.require: same company and actual original cost/posted parent binding

canonicalMappings.source: valueCode for the dimension whose code equals captured shortcutDimension2Code
canonicalMappings.require: same company and actual original cost/posted parent binding

canonicalMappings.source: explicit original source field or approved export only
canonicalMappings.require: do not substitute dimensionSetLine.id, parentId, dimensionId or concatenated values

dimensions.retain: All returned dimension lines and native references, including dimensions beyond canonical dimension_1/dimension_2.
dimensions.readback: Compare exact company + parent + dimension/value identity sets after target import; retain supported target IDs separately from original IDs.
dimensions.allocation: A dimension labels an accounting classification. It does not establish a split percentage or monetary amount. Existing allocation review retains exact signed cost and quantity conservation independently.
dimensions.postingPolicy: Retain actual defaults, priorities, allowed values and blocked combinations when available; unresolved policy stays an explicit cutover input.

exactAmounts.preserve: original numeric token in bodyText; exact-decimal canonical engine value separately
prohibit: JSON Number round-trip for money or quantities
unit-price multiplication to invent posted cost
combining LCY and additional reporting currency
exactAmounts.engineConstraint: Canonical currency is exactly three uppercase letters; unsupported original codes remain source evidence until an attributed explicit mapping is approved. No automatic code normalization.
exactAmounts.roundingPolicy: Retain amount rounding, display decimals, quantity/UoM and any conversion policy independently. A source value is not changed merely to match display precision.

readback.updateRule: Use the exact original ETag for a reviewed PATCH. A mismatch requires fresh read/reconciliation; do not replace with wildcard to suppress the conflict.
readback.successRule: Retain actual response and independent target readback for selected fields and posted effects. A200 or matching record count alone is insufficient.
readback.limits: GET/master CRUD does not establish historical ledger import or posting support. Resolve actual supplier-approved import action and installed API metadata.

requiredOriginals: complete asset master and maintenance-to-financial links
original financial events and posting dates
historicalFinance.rule: Retain acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, adjustments and net book value as separate declared measures. Avoid replaying costs already included in opening balances or capitalized assets.
historicalFinance.workOrderBoundary: Maintenance expense/history and fixed-asset acquisition/depreciation remain separate domains until explicit original source linkage and accounting classification support a reconciliation.
